rationale: EO 9680 (January 17, 1946) abolished the United States of America Typhus Commission, established by EO 9285 of December 24, 1942, and directed the Secretary of War to supervise its liquidation. The order states the abolition is as of June 30, 1946, a date fixed by its own terms, and has a single paragraph of operative text (abolition) plus a liquidation direction. The status is NO: by its own terms the commission was abolished as of June 30, 1946, a self-executing abolition, and no held source revives it. The ending source is the order's own operative text; the creating order EO 9285 is the held record that identifies the body abolished. Note on the basis ids: the ending is the order's own operative text (CLAUSES id); ACTOR_TEXT:EO:9285 is the held creating order that identifies the body abolished and is included only because it is the dossier's sole actor record.
